_about: Shared cases for the skater registration-number check, which exists in both Java (backend/core RegistrationNumbers) and TypeScript (web/src/shared/logic/registrationNumber.ts). ADR-013 decision 3b; ADR-029 decision 4; FeatureDecriptions/Client Sign Up, Registration number.
Every `expect` is written by hand. Never generate one from either implementation.
`expect.number` is the cleaned form that is stored; `expect.problem` is the message shown instead. The check is shape only: a message never hints that a number was looked up.
The USA Hockey season check digit is a setting (ADR-029) and is off in these cases; Java's own tests cover it.
